      when p_mode='swap' and p_kind in ('apartment','house','room') then 'Tauschwohnung'
      when p_mode='rent' and p_kind='apartment' then 'Wohnung'
      when p_mode='rent' and p_kind='house' then 'Haus'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.prepare_current_delivery_queue()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  with stopped as (
    update public.delivery_events de
    set status='skipped',
        next_retry_at=null,
        error_message=case
          when not coalesce(p.is_active,false) then 'inactive search profile blocked by delivery guard'
          when p.profile_slot>1 and not app_private.user_is_premium(p.user_id) then 'profile slot requires premium'
          when not coalesce(l.is_active,false) then 'inactive listing blocked by delivery guard'
          when coalesce(l.quality_status,'unchecked')='rejected' then 'rejected listing blocked by delivery guard'
          when not coalesce(l.is_primary_listing,false) then 'deduplicated listing blocked by delivery guard'
          when not coalesce(s.enabled,false) or s.runtime_mode<>'live' or s.delivery_mode<>'live'
            then 'source not live blocked by delivery guard'
          when not app_private.matches_property_filters(p,l)
            then 'listing no longer matches current profile/category filters'
          else 'listing is not qualified as <=24h new inventory'
        end
    from public.listings l, public.sources s, public.search_profiles p
    where l.id=de.listing_id
      and s.id=l.source_id
      and p.id=de.profile_id
      and de.status in ('available','pending','failed')
      and coalesce(de.delivery_outcome_unknown,false)=false
      and (
        not coalesce(p.is_active,false)
        or (p.profile_slot>1 and not app_private.user_is_premium(p.user_id))
        or not coalesce(l.is_active,false)
        or coalesce(l.quality_status,'unchecked')='rejected'
        or not coalesce(l.is_primary_listing,false)
        or not coalesce(s.enabled,false)
        or s.runtime_mode<>'live'
        or s.delivery_mode<>'live'
        or not app_private.matches_property_filters(p,l)
        or (
          coalesce(de.event_type,'new_listing')='new_listing'
          and not app_private.delivery_newness_qualified(l.id,statement_timestamp())
        )
      )
    returning de.id
  )
  select count(*) into v_count from stopped;
  return v_count;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.provider_object_identity(p_raw jsonb, p_evidence jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with x as (
    select
      app_private.canonical_provider_entity(coalesce(
        p_raw->>'provider_entity',
        p_evidence#>>'{preview,facts,provider_entity}',
        case when p_raw->>'saga_object_ref' is not null then 'SAGA' end
      )) as entity,
      upper(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(
        p_raw->>'provider_object_ref',
        p_raw->>'saga_object_ref',
        p_evidence#>>'{preview,facts,provider_object_ref}',
        p_evidence#>>'{preview,facts,saga_object_ref}',
        p_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,saga_object_ref}',
        ''
      )),'[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*','/','g'),'[[:space:]]+',' ','g')) as ref
  )
  select case when entity is not null and length(ref)>=4 then entity||'|'||ref else null end
  from x;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.queue_saved_listing_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.delivery_events(
    profile_id,listing_id,dedupe_key,status,delivery_format,
    recipient_user_id,event_type,change_id,next_retry_at,channel
  )
  select
    profile.id,
    new.listing_id,
    'change:'||new.id::text||':'||sl.user_id::text,
    case when u.telegram_user_id is not null and u.chat_id is not null
      then 'pending' else 'available' end,
    case when u.telegram_user_id is not null and u.chat_id is not null
      then 'photo_card' else 'web_match' end,
    sl.user_id,
    'listing_changed',
    new.id,
    null,
    case when u.telegram_user_id is not null and u.chat_id is not null
      then 'telegram' else 'web' end
  from public.saved_listings sl
  join public.bot_users u
    on u.id=sl.user_id
   and u.is_active=true
  join lateral (
    select p.id
    from public.search_profiles p
    where p.user_id=sl.user_id and p.is_active=true
    order by p.profile_slot,p.created_at
    limit 1
  ) profile on true
  where sl.listing_id=new.listing_id
  on conflict do nothing;

  return new;
end
$function$

routines.name: reconcile_recent_user_applications
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.reconcile_recent_user_applications(p_user uuid, p_provider text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_window interval DEFAULT '48:00:00'::interval, p_limit integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_inserted integer := 0;
  v_window interval;
begin
  if p_user is null then
    return 0;
  end if;
  if p_provider is not null
     and p_provider not in ('immoscout','kleinanzeigen','immowelt','immomio')
  then
    raise exception 'invalid_provider';
  end if;
  if p_limit is not null and p_limit < 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid_limit';
  end if;

  v_window := least(coalesce(p_window, interval '48 hours'), interval '168 hours');
  if v_window <= interval '0' then
    return 0;
  end if;

  with candidates as (
    select distinct on (u.id,l.id)
      u.id as user_id,
      l.id as listing_id,
      l.source_id,
      d.created_at
    from public.delivery_events d
    join public.bot_users u on u.id=d.recipient_user_id
    join public.listings l on l.id=d.listing_id
    join public.sources s on s.id=l.source_id
    cross join lateral (
      select app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url) as provider
    ) target
    where u.id=p_user
      and d.event_type='new_listing'
      and d.channel='telegram'
      and d.status in ('pending','processing','sent')
      and coalesce(d.delivery_outcome_unknown,false)=false
      and d.created_at >= clock_timestamp()-v_window
      and target.provider is not null
      and (p_provider is null or target.provider=p_provider)
      and app_private.delivery_newness_qualified(l.id,statement_timestamp())
      and u.is_active
      and app_private.user_is_premium(u.id)
      and app_private.applicant_profile_identity_ready(u.id)
      and app_private.application_provider_preference_enabled(u.id,target.provider)
      and app_private.application_target_ready(u.id,l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url)
      and app_private.application_listing_auto_apply_allowed(l.title,l.property_type,l.raw)
      and l.is_active
      and coalesce(l.quality_status,'unchecked')<>'rejected'
      and coalesce(l.is_primary_listing,false)
      and s.enabled
      and s.runtime_mode='live'
      and s.delivery_mode='live'
    order by u.id,l.id,d.created_at desc
  ), limited as (
    select *
    from candidates
    order by created_at desc
    limit coalesce(p_limit,2147483647)
  )
  insert into public.applications(user_id,listing_id,source_id)
  select user_id,listing_id,source_id
  from limited
  on conflict(user_id,listing_id) do nothing;

  get diagnostics v_inserted = row_count;
  return v_inserted;
end
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_user uuid, p_provider text, p_window interval, p_limit integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.record_source_neighborhood_coverage(p_source_id integer, p_neighborhood_id smallint, p_search_status text, p_result_count integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_strategy text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_evidence_quality text DEFAULT 'unknown'::text, p_evidence jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_attempted_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_attempted_at timestamptz := coalesce(p_attempted_at,now());
begin
  if p_search_status not in ('searched_with_hits','searched_no_hits','not_searchable','ambiguous') then raise exception 'invalid_neighborhood_search_status'; end if;
  if p_result_count is not null and p_result_count < 0 then raise exception 'invalid_neighborhood_result_count'; end if;
  if p_search_status='searched_with_hits' and p_result_count=0 then raise exception 'hits_status_requires_positive_result_count'; end if;
  if p_search_status='searched_no_hits' and p_result_count>0 then raise exception 'no_hits_status_requires_zero_result_count'; end if;
  if p_evidence_quality not in ('official','verified','inferred','weak','unknown') then raise exception 'invalid_neighborhood_evidence_quality'; end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_evidence,'{}'::jsonb)) <> 'object' then raise exception 'neighborhood_evidence_must_be_object'; end if;
  insert into app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage(source_id,neighborhood_id,search_status,result_count,last_attempt_at,last_success_at,strategy,evidence_quality,evidence)
  values(p_source_id,p_neighborhood_id,p_search_status,p_result_count,v_attempted_at,
    case when p_search_status in ('searched_with_hits','searched_no_hits') then v_attempted_at else null end,
    nullif(left(trim(coalesce(p_strategy,'')),120),''),p_evidence_quality,coalesce(p_evidence,'{}'::jsonb))
  on conflict(source_id,neighborhood_id) do update set
    search_status=excluded.search_status,result_count=excluded.result_count,last_attempt_at=excluded.last_attempt_at,
    last_success_at=case when excluded.search_status in ('searched_with_hits','searched_no_hits') then excluded.last_attempt_at else app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage.last_success_at end,
    strategy=excluded.strategy,evidence_quality=excluded.evidence_quality,evidence=excluded.evidence,updated_at=now()
  where not (
    app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage.search_status in ('searched_with_hits','searched_no_hits')
    and app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage.evidence_quality in ('official','verified')
    and excluded.search_status in ('ambiguous','not_searchable')
    and excluded.evidence_quality in ('weak','unknown')
  )
  and (
    app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage.last_attempt_at < now()-interval '24 hours'
    or app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage.search_status is distinct from excluded.search_status
    or app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage.result_count is distinct from excluded.result_count
    or app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage.strategy is distinct from excluded.strategy
    or app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage.evidence_quality is distinct from excluded.evidence_quality
  );
end;
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_source_id integer, p_neighborhood_id smallint, p_search_status text, p_result_count integer, p_strategy text, p_evidence_quality text, p_evidence jsonb, p_attempted_at timestamp with time zone

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.refresh_listing_dedupe_group(p_group_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_winner uuid;
begin
  if p_group_id is null then return null; end if;
  select l.id into v_winner
  from public.listings l
  join public.sources s on s.id=l.source_id
  where l.dedupe_group_id=p_group_id
    and l.is_active=true
    and l.quality_status<>'rejected'
  order by
    case
      when app_private.provider_object_identity(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence) is not null
       and s.source_type='Baugenossenschaft'
       and (
         coalesce(l.canonical_url,'') ~* '^https://tenant[.]immomio[.]com/'
         or coalesce(l.raw->>'applicationLink','') ~* '^https://tenant[.]immomio[.]com/'
       )
      then 1 else 0
    end desc,
    case
      when app_private.provider_object_identity(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence) is not null
        then coalesce(l.fresh_delivery_eligible,false)::int
      when app_private.saga_object_ref(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence) is not null
        then coalesce(l.fresh_delivery_eligible,false)::int
      else 0
    end desc,
    s.listing_priority asc,
    ((l.resolved_image_url is not null)::int+(l.address is not null)::int
     +(l.warm_rent is not null)::int+(l.cold_rent is not null)::int
     +(l.rooms is not null)::int+(l.area_sqm is not null)::int
     +(l.deposit is not null or l.deposit_text is not null)::int) desc,
    l.first_seen_at asc,l.id
  limit 1;

  update public.listings
  set is_primary_listing=(v_winner is not null and id=v_winner),
      duplicate_of_listing_id=case when v_winner is null or id=v_winner then null else v_winner end
  where dedupe_group_id=p_group_id
    and (is_primary_listing is distinct from (v_winner is not null and id=v_winner)
      or duplicate_of_listing_id is distinct from
         (case when v_winner is null or id=v_winner then null else v_winner end));

  update public.listing_dedupe_groups
  set preferred_listing_id=v_winner,updated_at=now()
  where id=p_group_id and preferred_listing_id is distinct from v_winner;

  return v_winner;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.require_deliverable_delivery_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_listing record;
begin
  select
    l.is_active,
    l.is_primary_listing,
    l.quality_status,
    s.enabled as source_enabled,
    s.runtime_mode,
    s.delivery_mode
  into v_listing
  from public.listings l
  join public.sources s on s.id=l.source_id
  where l.id=new.listing_id;

  if not found then return null; end if;

  if not coalesce(v_listing.is_active,false)
     or not coalesce(v_listing.is_primary_listing,false)
     or coalesce(v_listing.quality_status,'unchecked')='rejected'
     or not coalesce(v_listing.source_enabled,false)
     or v_listing.runtime_mode<>'live'
     or v_listing.delivery_mode<>'live'
  then
    return null;
  end if;

  if coalesce(new.event_type,'new_listing')='new_listing'
     and not app_private.delivery_newness_qualified(new.listing_id,statement_timestamp())
  then
    return null;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.saga_object_ref(p_raw jsonb, p_evidence jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when v ~ '^MO [0-9]{4}/[A-Z0-9.-]+/[A-Z0-9.-]+$' then v
    else null
  end
  from (
    select upper(
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(
          btrim(coalesce(
            p_raw->>'saga_object_ref',
            p_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,saga_object_ref}',
            p_evidence#>>'{preview,facts,saga_object_ref}',
            ''
          )),
          '[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*','/','g'
        ),
        '[[:space:]]+',' ','g'
      )
    ) as v
  ) x;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.saga_recovery_probe_candidate_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select l.id
  from public.listings l
  join public.sources s on s.id=l.source_id
  where l.source_id in (1,3)
    and l.is_active=true
    and coalesce(l.is_primary_listing,false)=true
    and coalesce(l.quality_status,'unchecked')<>'rejected'
    and l.first_seen_at < statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours'
    and l.last_seen_at >= statement_timestamp()-interval '30 minutes'
    and s.enabled=true and s.runtime_mode='live' and s.delivery_mode='live'
    and l.raw->>'provider_entity'='SAGA'
    and app_private.saga_object_ref(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence) is not null
    and (
      coalesce(
        nullif(l.raw->>'applicationLink',''),
        nullif(l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,application_url}',''),
        nullif(l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_shared,application_url}','')
      ) ~* '^https://tenant[.]immomio[.]com/(de/)?apply/[0-9a-f-]{36}/?$'
      or app_private.verified_saga_application_url(
        app_private.saga_object_ref(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence),
        l.id
      ) is not null
    )
    and (
      l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,status}' is null
      or (
        l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,status}'='error'
        and coalesce((l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,next_check_at}')::timestamptz,'-infinity'::timestamptz)<=statement_timestamp()
      )
    )
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.search_profiles p
      join public.bot_users u on u.id=p.user_id and u.is_active=true
      where p.is_active=true
        and (p.profile_slot=1 or app_private.user_is_premium(p.user_id))
        and app_private.matches_property_filters(p,l)
        and not exists (
          select 1
          from public.delivery_events de
          join public.listings oldl on oldl.id=de.listing_id
          where de.recipient_user_id=p.user_id
            and de.status='sent'
            and (
              oldl.dedupe_group_id=l.dedupe_group_id
              or app_private.saga_object_ref(oldl.raw,oldl.enrichment_evidence)
                 =app_private.saga_object_ref(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence)
            )
        )
    )
  order by l.first_seen_at desc,l.id
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.sync_legacy_auto_apply_preferences()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.application_preferences(
    user_id,enabled,immoscout_enabled,kleinanzeigen_enabled,immomio_enabled,immowelt_enabled
  )
  values(
    new.id,
    new.auto_apply_enabled,
    new.auto_apply_enabled,
    new.auto_apply_enabled,
    new.auto_apply_enabled,
    new.auto_apply_enabled
  )
  on conflict (user_id) do update
  set enabled=excluded.enabled,
      updated_at=now();

  if not new.auto_apply_enabled then
    update public.applications
    set status='failed',
        last_error='auto_apply_disabled',
        wait_reason=null,
        lease_until=null,
        next_attempt_at=null
    where user_id=new.id
      and status='pending'
      and submission_started_at is null;
  elsif tg_op='INSERT' then
    perform app_private.reconcile_recent_user_applications(new.id,null,interval '48 hours',null);
  elsif old.auto_apply_enabled is distinct from true then
    perform app_private.reconcile_recent_user_applications(new.id,null,interval '48 hours',null);
  end if;

  return new;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.user_has_application_provider(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.platform_connections c
    where c.user_id=p_user
      and c.status='connected'
      and (
        c.provider='immomio'
        or (
          c.provider='kleinanzeigen'
          and exists(select 1 from app_private.application_platforms p where p.source_id=2 and p.verified_at is not null)
        )
        or (
          c.provider='immoscout'
          and exists(select 1 from app_private.application_platforms p where p.source_id=1 and p.verified_at is not null)
        )
        or (
          c.provider='immowelt'
          and exists(select 1 from app_private.application_platforms p where p.source_id=3 and p.verified_at is not null)
        )
      )
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.user_is_premium(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.bot_users u
    where u.id=p_user and (
      (u.plan_override='premium' and (u.plan_override_expires_at is null or u.plan_override_expires_at>now()))
      or (u.plan_override is distinct from 'free' and u.referral_bonus_until>now())
      or (u.plan_override is distinct from 'free' and exists (
        select 1 from public.user_subscriptions s
        where s.user_id=u.id and s.status in ('active','trialing')
          and (s.current_period_end is null or s.current_period_end>now())
      ))
    )
  );
$function$

routines.name: validate_application_preferences
verified_saga_application_url
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.verified_saga_application_url(p_saga_ref text, p_exclude_listing_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with normalized as (
    select upper(
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(p_saga_ref,'')),'[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*','/','g'),
        '[[:space:]]+',' ','g'
      )
    ) as ref
  )
  select coalesce(
    nullif(l.raw->>'applicationLink',''),
    nullif(l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,application_url}',''),
    nullif(l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_shared,application_url}','')
  )
  from public.listings l, normalized n
  where (p_exclude_listing_id is null or l.id<>p_exclude_listing_id)
    and app_private.saga_object_ref(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence)=n.ref
    and (
      l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,immomio_status}'='online'
      or l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_shared,verified}'='true'
    )
    and coalesce(
      nullif(l.raw->>'applicationLink',''),
      nullif(l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,application_url}',''),
      nullif(l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_shared,application_url}','')
    ) ~* '^https://tenant[.]immomio[.]com/(de/)?apply/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/?$'
  order by greatest(
    coalesce((l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_probe,checked_at}')::timestamptz,'-infinity'::timestamptz),
    coalesce((l.enrichment_evidence#>>'{saga_shared,verified_at}')::timestamptz,'-infinity'::timestamptz)
  ) desc
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.acquire_dispatcher(p_owner uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update app_private.dispatch_control set owner=p_owner,expires_at=now()+interval '10 minutes'
 where singleton and (owner is null or expires_at<now());
 return found;
end $function$
